Name: Missile Magnet
Components: V, M (a sliver of magnetic iron)
Description:
You curse a target, drawing projectiles toward it. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. If it fails, it is wreathed in a nimbus of emerald light that sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius and attracts projectiles.

For the duration:
● Ranged attack rolls against the target have advantage.
● The target loses any benefits from half cover and three-quarters cover against ranged attacks.
● It takes an additional 1d4 force damage from ranged attacks that hit it.

Additionally, ranged attack rolls that would hit a creature within 5 feet of the cursed target force that creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the cursed target is hit by the attack instead, even if the attack roll is lower than its own AC.

At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw, ending the spell on a success. A remove curse spell or similar magic also ends the effect early.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the additional damage from projectiles increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 3rd.
